decisions.reason: The chosen closed product tube and meridian are supplied in the Statement. F1 uses the exterior and orientation conventions only; it does not invoke existence of a normal bundle or a tubular map. The finite torus chain calculation, collar excision and pair sequence give H2(S3,E)=Z and an isomorphism to H1(E) on the positive normal-disk boundary without a choice premise. Countable choice in the general tube-construction interface is therefore unused here.

F1 incorrectly grouped dotted R with the zero-framed components. Only B and G are framed 2-handle attaching circles; R specifies a 1-handle. Corrected F1 without changing the Statement. The proof uses a signed parallel, a strip in the punctured disk and a product-bigon isotopy to remove one intersection per slide, so this wording defect did not invalidate the construction. Also corrected the Hom background locator to sections 5–6; Piccirillo Theorem 3.1 is the actual slide source.

Confirmed the F3 misattribution: the sphere-homology corollary does not assert ball contractibility. The needed vanishing is elementary and true, so this is nonfatal citation repair. F3 now supplies explicit radial contractions and cites the contractible-space homology corollary; it separately cites homotopy invariance and sphere homology for the normal-circle bundle. Excision and both natural pair sequences identify the oriented normal disk generator and the boundary inclusion isomorphism; Statement unchanged.

The rejection overlooks the supplied lemma proof: steps 1.1–3.1 explicitly construct a signed framed parallel and strip band, then a product-bigon isotopy changing the intersection count from N to N−1; step 4.1 iterates it finitely. Thus F5 accurately records an established construction, although its Statement gives only existence. Independently checked the linking-coordinate comparison, f(G±B)=f(G)+f(B)±2lk(B,G), zero-framing induction and both geometric cancellations. No item edit is needed.

Confirmed the missing comparison with the fixed attaching framing: F2 defines preferred curves but asserts no uniqueness. Repaired 1.1 by writing the two section classes as [K′]=[s0]+n[μ] on the product torus; both vanish in the exterior and the meridian has infinite order, so n=0. A periodic angle lift then homotopes the normal framings and gives isotopic attaching tubes. Also made the reverse argument use a small round stereographic ball, whose complement is standard by inversion. The Statement is unchanged.

Confirmed the invalid radial vector: at (x,0,0) in round S4 the radial (x,0,0) is perpendicular to TS4. Replaced it with the explicit tangent normal frame e4,e5 and product tube (x,v)↦(sqrt(1−|v|²)x,v). Also repaired the digest finding in 3.1: slide one meridian over an opposite parallel along the inward strip of their product annulus; the cut-open annulus is a disk disjoint from the cancellation region and its product framing extends over that disk. Either cancellation then leaves the zero-framed unknot. Clarified 1.2 using two product disks to identify the whole trace. Example text unchanged.
